title: STAC: Spiking Transformer Augmenting Cognition
description: A research framework and study of converting pretrained transformer language models (DistilGPT-2, SmolLM2) into spiking neural networks. Includes a measured account of conversion fidelity, an operation-count energy analysis showing the current design projects worse than the dense ANN at its spike coverage, evidence that post-hoc conversion of a frozen model collapses to near-constant output without training, and a spike-aware fine-tuning path that recovers quality. Software-level simulation only; no physical neuromorphic-hardware measurements.
